scenes.story_beat: Ms. Vance slowly clicks her metallic pen under cold overhead fluorescent lights across the sleek glass desk with sharp corporate scrutiny.

Ms. Vance slowly lowers her designer spectacles through subtle volumetric room haze across the polished glass tabletop with a subtle cynical smirk.
